requirements.title: User authentication
requirements.description: Users must be able to register with an email and a password, sign in to obtain a session token, and sign out to revoke it.

requirements.title: Task management
requirements.description: Authenticated users must be able to create, list, update, and delete tasks.

requirements.title: Notification delivery
requirements.description: The system must deliver a notification alert to a user when a task is assigned to them.
